actual_rule_observed: Setting eleventyNavigation.parent to an existing top-level key moves the page out of the top-level list and into that key's children array, as its only child (index 0).
notes: Docs: "To nest a template inside of the Mammals template, use `parent: Mammals`" and "Any templates that do not have `parent` will be assumed to be at the top level." Confirmed: ProbeFive left the top-level list and appeared as Archive's child at index 0 within the section (Archive.children = [ProbeFive]). The starter's base.njk only renders top-level entries, so for this probe the layout was TEMPORARILY patched to render one nested level (li.nav-item > ul.nav-children > li.nav-child); the exact patch was reverted afterwards along with the probe page (git working tree clean). landed_at_index is the index within the Archive section. P5-after.html shows the nested nav HTML from the patched-template build.
